overview: Learnify is a premium education consultancy and academic ecosystem platform (SSN Initiative) led by Dr. S. Mithun. It guides students and working professionals in selecting higher education opportunities, connecting them with UGC-recognized Indian universities and international institutions. The platform serves both students and academic professionals with comprehensive services spanning education pathways, research, IP, PR, funding, career credentials, global profile building, and institutional partnerships.
features: Premium Navy Blue + Gold design with expert-led messaging
Hero with trust stats: 1000+ Students, 70+ Universities, 95% Success Rate
12 upgraded testimonials with Name/City/Program/Career Result format
10 expert testimonials from Academic Mentors and Career Advisors
12 Service Detail Pages (Online MBA, PhD, Patents, Study Abroad, etc.)
Social proof counters and urgency indicators
